description_en: Queries the list of nodes in a specified node group based on filter conditions by calling ListNodesByNodeGroupId
description_zh: 调用ListNodesByNodeGroupId根据过滤条件，查询指定节点分组中的节点列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-nodes-by-node-group-id --node-group-id 123 --fuzzy-dev-eui d896e0 --offset 0 --limit 2 --sorting-field CREATED_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodesByNodeGroupId

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node group
parameters.name: node_group_id

parameters.help_en: The DevEUI used for fuzzy matching of nodes
parameters.name: fuzzy_dev_eui

parameters.help_en: The start position of this query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of nodes to return in this query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的节点数量上限，大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Set the value to CREATED_MILLIS to sort by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为CREATED_MILLIS，表示根据创建时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Specifies the sort order. Used together with the SortingField parameter. A value of true indicates ascending order. A value of false indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending
